name: Weapon Master
about: Takes coin and gives it back as practice, a rack of blunted sparring blades behind him and a real one worn at his hip.
greetings: Show me how you hold it.
You are quick. You are not accurate.
Practice is cheaper than a funeral.
gossip: A dagger lands everything and finishes nothing. Know which fight you are in.
Two squares of reach is worth more than two points of damage.
Nobody is good with every weapon. Pick one and stop apologising.
